Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks for the questions — below are the concise answers from our infra/security team. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want more detail.

1) Customer-managed keys (BYOK) & HSM support
   - We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments. Keys can be provided via your cloud KMS (e.g., AWS KMS CMKs) and configured as CMKs for disk and object encryption.
   - HSM-backed keys: Supported via CloudHSM for AWS and HSM-backed Key Vaults on Azure for our Private deployments; for Dedicated deployments we offer integrations with customer-managed HSMs in your VPC.

2) Key rotation
   - Rotation can be automated (policy-driven) or manual. We recommend rotation schedules aligned with your policies. Rotation is a new-envelope encryption for new objects; existing cached KV entries are re-encrypted on access. There's no expected downtime — cache warm-up may be needed on first access after rotation.

3) Logs and PII
   - Application request/response logs do not store raw PII or PHI by default. We persist structured metadata (timestamps, request IDs, model variant, token counts) and hashed request identifiers for traceability.
   - Trace and debug logs can be configured; by default sensitive payloads are redacted. Default retention for detailed traces is 90 days; aggregated metrics are retained according to your plan (can be extended).

4) In-transit & at-rest encryption
   - In-transit: TLS 1.2+ with modern cipher suites, mandatory for all endpoints.
   - At-rest: AES-256 for object and disk encryption; keys are managed per-account and can be backed by your KMS.

5) Data residency / on-prem options
   - We support single-region configurations for data and logs (e.g., us-east-1) on Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted customers can choose regional tenancy when available; for strict residency we recommend a Private deployment.
   - On-prem KMS: For Private deployments we can integrate with on-prem HSMs or customer KMS via secure tunnels and customer-managed connectors.
